answer: Anchor every agent identity to a refundable stake plus a public work history: each agent is a vertex in a reputation graph, and new vertices must complete small peer-attested jobs before they can move value. Like a juniper that only grows strong through slow, verifiable seasons, trust accrues over time and cannot be bought in bulk; a nebula of fresh throwaway accounts may appear overnight, but without stake and attestation history it carries no weight.
